task: ai-bookkeeper flagship item (5), receipts OCR: a new held-out photo source (WildReceipt) and rules from its train shard
errors: First OCR launch: `cd X && ... ( ... ) &` backgrounded the whole and-list, so the cd did not apply to the next commands and pip/apt logs landed in ventures/ai-bookkeeper (removed before commit).
Started OCR on podbilabs/wildreceipt-donut JPEGs believing them downscaled; the kaydee PNG originals turned out to be the same sizes. Lost about 3 minutes of OCR.
integrity_issues: Before moving development to WildReceipt train shard 0, the run printed the held-out test set's miss list and read four test receipts in full; three of the 'not the total' rules (TOTAL SAVED, TOTAL INCLUDES ... OF, German Netto) were first seen there, then re-found on train0. Disclosed in eval/wildreceipt-2026-11-17.md, the README and the post. The held-out baseline was taken before any change and the test was scored once after.

doc_friction.issue: ai-bookkeeper's buildable said 'All CORD photos are read; fresh ones need a new source' without naming a candidate; WildReceipt on Hugging Face (kaydee/wildreceipt, with photos) took a few probes to find (openmmlab's tarball resets, Theivaprakasham's export has labels only). Now named in buildable.

goal: Measure the receipt reader on a photo source no rule was written from, and fix what its train photos show
notes: WildReceipt test (472 photos, 405 totals, 272 taxes), held out: five readings 357 -> 359 totals, tax 194 -> 204; page 356 -> 358, tax 191 -> 202; RapidOCR alone 355 -> 358, tax 164 -> 185. Train shard 0 (dev): five 449 -> 458, tax 297 -> 305. SRD totals unchanged 188/196, tax 162 -> 164. CORD text unchanged except train tax 324 -> 325. Venture suite: 3360 tests pass (run_venture_tests.py ai-bookkeeper). venture-preflight ai-bookkeeper: clean (exit 0).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: finding a new labelled receipt dataset, OCR of 1,300 photos with two engines, parser rules, before/after scoring on four sets and the write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
